create_UnCLIPTextProjModel: create a UnCLIPTextProjModel instance to project CLIP image and text embeddings for the decoder
forward_UnCLIPTextProjModel: run the forward pass of UnCLIPTextProjModel with image embeddings, prompt embeds, and text encoder hidden states
project_clip_embeddings: project CLIP image embeddings into extra context tokens concatenated to the text encoder output
compute_additive_time_embeddings: compute additive CLIP time embeddings by projecting and adding image and prompt embeddings
enable_classifier_free_guidance: enable classifier free guidance by adding learned embeddings to image embeddings during the forward pass
